findings.title: No basePath confinement when basePath is empty
findings.description: When no basePath is configured, the connector operates in 'cwd mode' and accepts any path including absolute paths anywhere on the filesystem. This is likely intentional (flexibility for trusted deployments) but should be documented in the usage examples.

findings.title: Unbounded cache growth
findings.description: The fileCache has no eviction policy beyond TTL expiry. For long-running engine processes loading many distinct files, this could accumulate entries indefinitely. Consider adding a max-entries limit or LRU eviction.

findings.title: Write operation returns resolved absolute path
findings.description: The write response includes {"ok": true, "path": resolvedPath} where resolvedPath is the absolute filesystem path. This exposes server-side path structure to flow authors. Consider returning the original relative path instead.
